name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.2 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 5 visits over 75 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.1 days starting 2026-05-18, at wavelengths from 0.81 to 4.40 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
